No code in the dataset cancels this listener's task, so onCancelled never runs.

The in-app cancels of a DeckTask all go through DeckTask.cancelTask(int) (DeckTask.java:181-184), which cancels the latest task only when its mType equals the argument. The only callers pass TASK_TYPE_SEARCH_CARDS (30) and TASK_TYPE_RENDER_BROWSER_QA (37) (CardBrowser.java:528-529, 796-797, 1155). The no-argument cancelTask() (DeckTask.java:168-178) has no caller besides cancelTask(int). The other cancel(true) calls act on non-DeckTask tasks: TaskOperations.stopTaskGracefully (TaskOperations.java:33), Connection (Connection.java:541), Statistics (Statistics.java:543, 574, 681, 692). So the DISMISS task (DeckTask.java:73) and the UPDATE_FACT task (DeckTask.java:71) are never cancelled.
